title: ACL
content:
Groups › ACL
groups.acl
ACL operations for Groups
client.groups.acl
get# client.groups.acl.get(...)Get the user access control list for a Worker Group, Outpost Group, or Edge Fleet.
Get the user access control list (ACL) for the specified Worker Group, Outpost Group, or Edge Fleet. This endpoint lists users with explicit access assignments on the Group or Fleet. The response does not include access granted through Team membership or inherited based on a user’s Permissions and Roles at the Organization/Global, Workspace, or product level. To list the Team ACL for a product and Group or Fleet, use GET /products/{product}/groups/{id}/acl/teams.
Example Usage# response = client.groups.acl.get( id="example", )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description id str Yes — The id of the Worker Group, Outpost Group, or Edge Fleet to get the ACL for product Literal["stream", "edge", "outpost"] No "stream" Name of the Cribl product that contains the Worker Group, Outpost Group, or Edge Fleet. Valid values: “stream”, “edge”, “outpost” type Literal["groups", "insights-apps", "datasets", "dataset-providers", "projects", "dashboards", "macros", "notebooks", "notebook-templates", "apps"] | None No — Filter for limiting the response to ACL entries for the specified RBAC resource type. Valid values: “groups”, “insights-apps”, “datasets”, “dataset-providers”, “projects”, “dashboards”, “macros”, “notebooks”, “notebook-templates”, “apps” Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing a list of UserAccessControlList objects.
response = client.groups.acl.get(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). NotFoundError 404 Worker Group, Outpost Group, or Edge Fleet not found. ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. List user ACL for a Group — Response
# Example response for listing the user access control list (ACL) for a Group. The response includes only users with explicit access assignments on the Group, not access granted through Team membership or inheritance. { "count": 1, "items": [ { "user": "user1@example.com", "perms": [{"type": "groups", "gid": "group1", "policy": "GroupRead"}], }, ], }

title: Captures
content:
System › Captures
system.captures
Capture operations
client.system.captures
create# client.system.captures.create(...)Capture live data as an NDJSON stream.
Initiate a live data capture from Cribl Workers. Yields CapturedEvent objects as they arrive over the wire (line-delimited JSON).
Example Usage# # Example request body for capturing events by sourcetype. client.system.captures.create( filter="sourcetype===\"pan:traffic\"", maxEvents=100, duration=5, level=0, )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description duration int | None No 5 Amount of time to keep capture open, in seconds filter str | None No — JavaScript expression evaluated against each event to determine whether an event is included in the capture output. Expressions can reference any event field and use logical operators. If not provided, all events are captured level int | None No 0 Stage at which events are captured maxEvents int | None No 100 Maximum number of events to capture stepDuration int | None No 5 How long to wait before increasing the capture sample size. Specify 1 second or longer workerId str | None No — Unique ID of the Worker workerThreshold int | None No 50 Maximum number of Workers that can capture initially. A value of 0 means unlimited (all available Workers can capture) Response# Generator[CapturedEvent]
for event in client.system.captures.create(...): print(event)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description ValidationError 400 Failed validation or malformed input — No worker nodes are connected to this worker group. AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Capture events using the AND operator to specify multiple conditions
# Example request body for capturing events using the AND operator to specify multiple conditions. client.system.captures.create( filter="sourcetype===\"pan:traffic\" && src_zone===\"trusted\"", maxEvents=100, duration=5, level=0, )Capture events using dot notation to specify nested fields
# Example request body for capturing events using dot notation to specify nested fields. client.system.captures.create( filter="sourcetype===\"pan:traffic\" && dest_geoip.country.iso_code === \"US\"", maxEvents=100, duration=5, level=0, )Capture with a complex filter that uses JavaScript methods
# Example request body for capturing with a complex filter that uses JavaScript methods. client.system.captures.create( filter="__inputId.startsWith(\"http:\") && status >= 400 && status < 500", maxEvents=500, duration=15, level=1, )Return one captured event — Response
# Example response for streaming one captured event as an NDJSON line from a live data capture. { "_time": 1700000000, "_raw": "2023-11-14T22:13:20Z src=10.0.1.50 dst=192.168.1.100 action=allow", "sourcetype": "pan:traffic", "__inputId": "syslog:my_syslog_input", }

Update the specified Cribl system settings. Provide only the top-level sections (api, workers, tls, proxy, etc.) you want to change. Omitted sections stay unchanged. Each provided section fully replaces the existing one – send the complete section object, not only the changed fields.
Example Usage# # Example request body for updating the Cribl API server network and TLS settings. client.system.settings.cribl.update( api={ "host": "0.0.0.0", "port": 9000, "disabled": False, "ssl": { "disabled": False, "certificateName": "myApiCert", "privKeyPath": "/opt/cribl/local/cribl/auth/myApiCert.key", "certPath": "/opt/cribl/local/cribl/auth/myApiCert.crt", "passphrase": "", }, }, system={"upgrade": "api", "intercom": True}, shutdown={"drainTimeout": 10000}, sni={"disableSNIRouting": False}, pii={"enablePiiDetection": False}, workers={"count": 0, "minimum": 1, "memory": 0}, proxy={"useEnvVars": False}, tls={ "minVersion": "TLSv1.2", "maxVersion": "TLSv1.3", "defaultCipherList": "DEFAULT", "defaultEcdhCurve": "auto", "rejectUnauthorized": True, }, upgradeSettings={}, upgradeGroupSettings={ "quantity": 100, "isRolling": True, "retryDelay": 1000, "retryCount": 5, }, backups={ "backupsDirectory": "$CRIBL_STATE_DIR/backups", "backupPersistence": "24h", }, rollback={"rollbackEnabled": True}, # ... (see API docs for full payload) )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description api ApiSettingsParam | None No — API server configuration for the Cribl instance apps AppsSettingsParam | None No — App configuration backups BackupsSettingsParam | None No — Configuration backup settings, including storage location and retention period customLogo CustomLogoParam | None No — Custom logo configuration for the Cribl UI login page and navigation bar pii PiiSettingsParam | None No — Personally identifiable information (PII) detection configuration proxy ProxySettingsParam | None No — HTTP proxy configuration for outbound connections rollback RollbackSettingsParam | None No — Automatic rollback settings applied when an upgrade fails shutdown ShutdownSettingsParam | None No — Graceful shutdown configuration sni SniSettingsParam | None No — Server Name Indication (SNI) routing configuration sockets SocketsSettingsParam | None No — Unix domain socket configuration support SupportSettingsParam | None No — Support and diagnostics settings system SystemSettingsSystemParam | None No — System-level operational settings for the Cribl instance tls TlsSettingsParam | None No — Global TLS/SSL settings applied to all outbound connections that do not specify their own TLS configuration upgradeGroupSettings UpgradeGroupSettingsParam | None No — Rolling upgrade group settings that control how many nodes are upgraded at a time upgradeSettings UpgradeSettingsParam | None No — Automatic upgrade scheduling and package source configuration workers WorkersSettingsParam | None No — Worker Process configuration Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing the updated SystemSettings.
response = client.system.settings.cribl.update(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description ValidationError 400 Failed validation or malformed input, such as missing or invalid parameters. AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). AuthorizationError 403 Not authorized to perform this action. ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. To list the user ACL for a Group or Fleet, use GET /products/{product}/groups/{id}/acl.

title: Commits
content:
Versioning › Commits
versioning.commits
Commit operations
client.versioning.commits
Overview# Method Description create Create a new commit for pending changes to the Cribl configuration. diff Get the diff for a commit. get Get the diff and log message for a commit. list List the commit history. push Push local commits to the remote repository. revert Revert a commit in the local repository. undo Discard uncommitted (staged) changes. Operations# create# client.versioning.commits.create(...)Create a new commit for pending changes to the Cribl configuration.
Any merge conflicts indicated in the response must be resolved using Git. To commit only a subset of configuration changes, specify the files to include in the commit in the files array.
Example Usage# # Example request body for committing all pending changes to the Cribl configuration. client.versioning.commits.create( message="Updated pipeline configuration for syslog parsing", )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description message str Yes — Commit message to use for the new Git commit effective bool | None No — If true, apply the commit to the group’s effective configuration. Requires a group context files list[str] | None No — Array of file paths to include in the commit, relative to the configuration root. If omitted, all pending changes are committed Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing GitCommitSummary objects.
response = client.versioning.commits.create(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description ValidationError 400 When effective: true is provided without a group context. AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Commit changes in specific files
# Example request body for committing a subset of configuration changes to specific files. client.versioning.commits.create( message="Update Route and Pipeline for HTTP Sources", effective=True, files=[ "groups/default/local/cribl/pipelines/http_input/conf.yml", "groups/default/local/cribl/routes.yml", ], )Commit created — Response
# Example response for creating a new commit for pending configuration changes. {"count": 1, "items": [...]} # ... (see API docs for full payload)diff# client.versioning.commits.diff(...)Get the diff for a commit.
Default is the latest commit (HEAD).
Example Usage# response = client.versioning.commits.diff()Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description commit str | None No — The Git commit hash to get the diff for filename str | None No — The relative path of the file to get the diff for diffLineLimit int | None No — Number of lines of the diff to return. Default is 1000. Set to 0 to return the full diff, regardless of the number of lines Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing the requested GitDiffResult.
response = client.versioning.commits.diff(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Diff for a commit — Response
# Example response for getting the diff of changes in a commit. { "count": 1, "items": [ { "diffJson": [ { "oldName": "groups/default/local/cribl/pipelines/http_input/conf.yml", "newName": "groups/default/local/cribl/pipelines/http_input/conf.yml", "addedLines": 5, "deletedLines": 2, "isCombined": False, "isGitDiff": True, "language": "yml", "blocks": [], }, ], }, ], }get# client.versioning.commits.get(...)Get the diff and log message for a commit.
Default is the latest commit (HEAD).
Example Usage# response = client.versioning.commits.get()Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description commit str | None No — The Git commit hash to retrieve the diff and log message for filename str | None No — The relative path of the file to get the diff and log message for diffLineLimit int | None No — Number of lines of the diff to return. Default is 1000. Set to 0 to return the full diff, regardless of the number of lines Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing the requested GitShowResult.
response = client.versioning.commits.get(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Diff and log message for a commit — Response
# Example response for getting the diff and log message for a commit. { "count": 1, "items": [ { "commitMessage": "Updated syslog pipeline configuration", "diffJson": [ { "oldName": "groups/default/local/cribl/pipelines/syslog/conf.yml", "newName": "groups/default/local/cribl/pipelines/syslog/conf.yml", "addedLines": 3, "deletedLines": 1, "isCombined": False, "isGitDiff": True, "language": "yml", "blocks": [], }, ], }, ], }list# client.versioning.commits.list(...)List the commit history.
Analogous to git log for the Cribl configuration, allowing you to audit and review changes over time.
Example Usage# response = client.versioning.commits.list()Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description count int | None No — Maximum number of commits to read from the commit history. When provided, offset and limit are applied to that read set offset int | None No — Pagination offset limit int | None No — Maximum number of items to return Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing GitLogResult objects.
response = client.versioning.commits.list(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. List commit history — Response
# Example response for listing the commit history of the Cribl configuration repository. { "count": 2, "items": [...], "offset": 0, "limit": 20, } # ... (see API docs for full payload)push# client.versioning.commits.push(...)Push local commits to the remote repository.
Push all local commits from the local repository to the remote repository. Requires at least one local commit that has not been pushed. Returns an error if the remote repository cannot be reached or the push is rejected.
Example Usage# response = client.versioning.commits.push()Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing str objects.
response = client.versioning.commits.push(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Push result — Response
# Example response for pushing local commits to the remote repository. { "count": 1, "items": [ "To https://github.com/example/cribl-config.git\n a1b2c3d..b2c3d4e main -> main", ], }revert# client.versioning.commits.revert(...)Revert a commit in the local repository.
Revert a commit in the local repository by creating a new commit that undoes the changes introduced by the specified commit. Use the force field to proceed even when the working directory is not clean.
Example Usage# # Example request body for reverting a specific commit. client.versioning.commits.revert( commit="a1b2c3d4e5f6", )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description commit str Yes — SHA-1 hash of the commit to revert force bool | None No — If true, force the revert even when the working directory is not clean. Otherwise, false message str | None No — Custom message to use for the revert commit. If omitted, a default message is generated Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing GitRevertResult objects.
response = client.versioning.commits.revert(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Force revert a commit with a custom message
# Example request body for force reverting a specific commit with a custom revert message. client.versioning.commits.revert( commit="a1b2c3d4e5f6", message="Revert commit due to misconfiguration in Pipeline settings", force=True, )Revert result — Response
# Example response for reverting a commit in the local repository. { "count": 1, "items": [ { "audit": { "id": "a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2", "files": { "modified": ["groups/default/local/cribl/pipelines/http_input/conf.yml"], }, }, "reverted": True, }, ], }undo# client.versioning.commits.undo(...)Discard uncommitted (staged) changes.
Discard all uncommitted (staged) configuration changes, resetting the working directory to the last committed state. Use only if you are certain that you do not need to preserve your local changes. When applied globally (no group), triggers a Cribl restart to reload the reverted configuration. Returns false if the working directory is already clean.
Example Usage# response = client.versioning.commits.undo()Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing bool objects.
response = client.versioning.commits.undo(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Undo result — Response
# Example response for discarding uncommitted changes. {"count": 1, "items": [True]}

title: Settings
content:
System › Settings
system.settings
Settings operations
client.system.settings
restart# client.system.settings.restart(...)Restart the Cribl server.
This operation requires system.restart to be set to api in cribl.yml. If this setting is not configured, the request returns a 403 error. Restarting the server causes a brief period of downtime while the process stops and restarts. All in-flight events are drained before the process exits. Use POST /system/settings/reload to apply configuration changes without a full restart.
Example Usage# response = client.system.settings.restart()Response# SDKResponse
(200) bool indicating restart was initiated.
response = client.system.settings.restart(...) print(response.data)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). AuthorizationError 403 Restart from the API is disabled. Set system.restart to api in cribl.yml to enable it. ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Initiate restart — Response
# Example response for a successful server restart request. The server will restart shortly after this response is returned. {"items": [{"restart": True}], "count": 1}

Determines how credentials are provided. title: Datasets
content:
Manage Cribl Lake Datasets.
client.datasets
Overview# Method Description create Create Lake Datasets (Cribl.Cloud only). delete Delete a Lake Dataset (Cribl.Cloud only). get Get a Lake Dataset (Cribl.Cloud only). list List all Lake Datasets (Cribl.Cloud only). update Update a Lake Dataset (Cribl.Cloud only). Operations# create# client.datasets.create(...)Create Lake Datasets (Cribl.Cloud only).
Creates one or more Lake Datasets in the specified Lake in a single transaction (Cribl.Cloud only). Send a single Lake Dataset object to create just one, or an array to bulk-create multiple. When an array is sent, the response is { items, errors } – items contains the successfully created Lake Datasets, and errors contains an entry ({ id, reason }) for each Lake Dataset that failed validation, so a per-item failure does not fail the rest of the batch.
Example Usage# # Example request body for creating a Lake Dataset in JSON format with a 90-day retention period. client.datasets.create( id="web_access_logs", description="Web server access logs", storageLocationId="my-storage-location", format="json", retentionPeriodInDays=90, acceleratedFields=[ "host", "status", ], )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description lakeId str Yes — The id of the Lake to create the Lake Datasets in id str Yes — Unique identifier for the Dataset acceleratedFields list[str] | None No — Accelerated fields for the Dataset. Data is partitioned by these fields in storage to improve query performance allowRecordErasure bool | None No — If true, the Dataset is opted in to Lake Record Erasure bucketName str | None No — Name of the legacy Cribl Lake bucket that backs the Dataset. Mutually exclusive with storageLocationId cacheConnection CacheConnectionParam | None No — Lakehouse cache connection settings for the Dataset deletionStartedAt int | None No — Timestamp (in Unix time) when Dataset deletion was initiated, in milliseconds description str | None No — Brief description of the Dataset format str | None No — Storage format used for data persisted in the Dataset httpDAUsed bool | None No — If true, the Dataset is used by Direct Access HTTP. Otherwise, false metrics DatasetMetricsParam | None No — Most recent Dataset metrics snapshot providerPath str | None No — Storage path within the provider (for example an S3 prefix or Azure container) retentionPeriodInDays int | None No — Dataset retention period, in days searchConfig DatasetSearchConfigParam | None No — Search configuration for the Dataset storageClass str | None No — Storage class used for objects written to the Dataset storageLocationId str | None No — Unique identifier for the Storage Location that backs the Dataset. Mutually exclusive with bucketName viewName str | None No — Name of the ClickHouse view for the Dataset on the Lakehouse Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing the created CriblLakeDataset.
response = client.datasets.create(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. Create a Lake Dataset in Parquet format
# Example request body for creating a Lake Dataset in Parquet format with a 365-day retention period and search configuration. client.datasets.create( id="security_events", description="Security event data in Parquet format", storageLocationId="my-storage-location", format="parquet", retentionPeriodInDays=365, searchConfig={ "datatypes": [ "palo_alto_firewall", "crowdstrike_fdr", ], }, )Create a minimal Lake Dataset
# Example request body for creating a Lake Dataset with only the required body parameters. client.datasets.create( id="app_logs", )Bulk create Lake Datasets
# Example request body for creating multiple new Lake Datasets in a single request. Send an array of objects — one per Lake Dataset to create, using the same fields as a single-item create (this example shows one such element). The response is { items, errors } : items contains the created Lake Datasets, and errors contains { id, reason } entries for any Lake Datasets that failed validation. client.datasets.create( id="web_access_logs", description="Web server access logs", storageLocationId="my-storage-location", format="json", retentionPeriodInDays=90, acceleratedFields=[ "host", "status", ], )delete# client.datasets.delete(...)Delete a Lake Dataset (Cribl.Cloud only).
Delete the specified Lake Dataset in the specified Lake (Cribl.Cloud only).
Example Usage# response = client.datasets.delete( lakeId="example", id="example", )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description lakeId str Yes — The id of the Lake that contains the Lake Dataset to delete id str Yes — The id of the Lake Dataset to delete Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing the deleted CriblLakeDataset.
response = client.datasets.delete(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. get# client.datasets.get(...)Get a Lake Dataset (Cribl.Cloud only).
Get the specified Lake Dataset in the specified Lake (Cribl.Cloud only).
Example Usage# response = client.datasets.get( lakeId="example", id="example", )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description lakeId str Yes — The id of the Lake that contains the Lake Dataset to get id str Yes — The id of the Lake Dataset to get includeMetrics bool | None No — Set to true to include storage metrics for each Lake Dataset. Otherwise, false (default). Requires a Cribl Lake metrics license Response# SDKResponse
(200) PaginatedResponse containing the requested CriblLakeDataset.
response = client.datasets.get(...) for item in response.data.items: print(item)Errors# This operation may raise the following SDK exceptions.
Error Status Code Description AuthenticationError 401 Authentication failed (missing or invalid credentials or Bearer token). ServerError 500 Unexpected server error. list# client.datasets.list(...)List all Lake Datasets (Cribl.Cloud only).
Get a list of all Lake Datasets in the specified Lake (Cribl.Cloud only).
Example Usage# response = client.datasets.list( lakeId="example", )Parameters# Parameter Type Required Default Description lakeId str Yes — The id of the Lake that contains the Lake Datasets to list storageLocationId str | None No — Filter datasets by storage location ID. Use default for default storage location format str | None No — Filter datasets by format. Set to ddss to return only DDSS datasets excludeDDSS bool | None No — Exclude DDSS format datasets from the response excludeNetskope bool | None No — Exclude Netskope format datasets from the response excludeDeleted bool | None No — Exclude deleted datasets from the response excludeInternal bool | None No — Exclude internal datasets (those with IDs starting with cribl_) from the response excludeBYOS bool | None No — Exclude BYOS (Bring Your Own Storage) datasets from the response includeMetrics bool | None No — Set to true to include storage metrics for each Lake Dataset. Otherwise, false (default). Requires a Cribl Lake metrics license offset int | None No — Starting point for catalog-backed pagination. Requires limit limit int | None No — Page size for catalog-backed pagination. Requires offset orderBy str | None No — Catalog sort field when paginating: name, createdAt, updatedAt, providerPath, type, or retentionPeriodInDays. Defaults to name orderDir str | None No — Sort direction when paginating: asc or desc. Defaults to asc name str | None No — Exact dataset name match (catalog path, with pagination) nameContains str | None No — Case-insensitive substring match on dataset name (catalog path, with pagination) providerPathContains str | None No — Case-insensitive substring match on provider path (catalog path, with pagination) descriptionContains str | None No — Case-insensitive substring match on description (catalog path, with pagination) Response# SDKResponse

Otherwise, false metrics DatasetMetricsParam | None No — Most recent Dataset metrics snapshot providerPath str | None No — Storage path within the provider (for example an S3 prefix or Azure container) retentionPeriodInDays int | None No — Dataset retention period, in days searchConfig DatasetSearchConfigParam | None No — Search configuration for the Dataset storageClass str | None No — Storage class used for objects written to the Dataset storageLocationId str | None No — Unique identifier for the Storage Location that backs the Dataset. Mutually exclusive with bucketName viewName str | None No — Name of the ClickHouse view for the Dataset on the Lakehouse Response# SDKResponse

Choose Auto to use IAM roles. reuseConnections bool | None No Reuse connections between requests, which can improve performance rejectUnauthorized bool | None No Reject certificates that cannot be verified against a valid CA, such as self-signed certificates bucket str Yes Name of the destination S3 bucket. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at initialization time. Example referencing a Global Variable: myBucket-${C.vars.myVar} region str | None No Region where the S3 bucket is located destPath str | None No Prefix to prepend to files before uploading. Must be a JavaScript expression (which can evaluate to a constant value), enclosed in quotes or backticks. Can be evaluated only at init time. Example referencing a Global Variable: myKeyPrefix-${C.vars.myVar} maxConcurrentFileParts float | None No Maximum number of parts to upload in parallel per file. Minimum part size is 5MB. verifyPermissions bool | None No Disable if you can access files within the bucket but not the bucket itself maxClosingFilesToBackpressure float | None No Maximum number of files that can be waiting for upload before backpressure is applied stagePath str Yes Filesystem location in which to buffer files, before compressing and moving to final destination. Use performant and stable storage. addIdToStagePath bool | None No Add the Output ID value to staging location removeEmptyDirs bool | None No Remove empty staging directories after moving files partitionExpr str | None No JavaScript expression defining how files are partitioned and organized. Default is date-based. The __format variable refers to the value of the Data format field (json or raw). The __compression field refers to the kind of compression being used (none or gzip). maxFileSizeMB float | None No Maximum uncompressed output file size. Files of this size will be closed and moved to final output location. maxFileOpenTimeSec float | None No Maximum amount of time to write to a file. Files open for longer than this will be closed and moved to final output location. maxFileIdleTimeSec float | None No Maximum amount of time to keep inactive files open.
